import pty, os, time, select

pid, fd = pty.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.execv('./src/pmars', ['./src/pmars', '-b', '-e', '-f', 'flashpaper.red', 'rave.red'])

def send(s, delay=0.3):
    time.sleep(delay)
    os.write(fd, s.encode())

def drain(dur=1.0):
    out = b''
    end = time.time() + dur
    while time.time() < end:
        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.1)
        if r:
            try:
                d = os.read(fd, 4096)
            except OSError:
                break
            if not d:
                break
            out += d
    return out

out = drain(2)
send('registers\n')
out += drain(1)
send('list 0-4\n')
out += drain(1)
send('quit\n')
out += drain(2)
try:
    os.close(fd)
except OSError:
    pass
_, status = os.waitpid(pid, 0)
print(repr(out.decode(errors='replace'))[:3000])
print("exit:", os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status))
EOF
